_readme: Everything identical for every Greenhouse customer. A company record under profiles/companies/ names "platform": "greenhouse" and adds only what differs: slug, name, careers_url, api.endpoint and health.

israel_filter._note: VERIFIED live 2026-08-13. post_fetch per SKILL Step 5 - the board API takes no location parameter, so the one call returns every posting worldwide and relevance is decided afterwards. BOTH fields are checked and that is not redundancy: Greenhouse routinely reports location.name as the literal string 'Multiple Locations', and offices[] is the only place the actual cities appear. Checking location.name alone silently drops Israeli roles at exactly the large multi-site companies most likely to have them. fetchers/api.py implements the OR across the two.

api._note: ?content=true on the endpoint is mandatory and is not only about descriptions: without it the response omits the data needed to resolve 'Multiple Locations'. It is also what makes detail_fetch below free.

detail_fetch._note: VERIFIED live (2026-08-12 on the posting named above, re-confirmed 2026-08-13 across other boards). inline is the ONLY viable method on Greenhouse: a posting PAGE serves the application form without the description, so method=html would silently read nothing. content_is_html=true is required and load-bearing - the field arrives both as HTML and HTML-escaped, so it must be unescaped before being parsed, or the text ends up full of literal '<p>'. This block is inherited from wiz.json, where it was verified against a real posting; it is platform behaviour, not company behaviour, which is why it belongs here.

health._note: Overridden per company by the importer from that company's live verified count - see the same note in comeet.json. The defaults are the safe direction.

notes: Endpoint template: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true. One call, no pagination: verified against `datadog`, the largest board reachable in this set at 437 postings, where len(jobs) == meta.total == 437 and an added &page=2 returned the same 437 - the parameter is simply ignored. 437 is well past any plausible 50- or 100-per-page cap, so this is a real test rather than a small-board coincidence. No EU/regional API host split was found: all 28 live boards in the shortlist answer on boards-api.greenhouse.io, unlike Lever. A dead board token returns HTTP 404 {"error":"Job not found"}, which surfaces as an ordinary fetch failure. Full evidence: _onboarding/verify_report.md.
